title: Marcos and Mexico's Sheinbaum seek advance trade deals
summary: SHENZHEN, China -- Philippine President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. and Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum are seeking to advance their countries" cooperation in trade and investment.

blocks.text: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. met with President Claudia Sheinbaum of Mexico on the sidelines of the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting. Photo from Presidential Communications Office
SHENZHEN, China — Philippine President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. and Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum are seeking to advance their countries’ cooperation in trade and investment.
This was discussed by the two leaders in a pull-aside meeting on the sidelines of the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting (AELM).
Marcos and Sheinbaum likewise reaffirmed the longstanding friendship between the Philippines and Mexico.
They also sought to improve cultural exchange between their two countries.
Both Marcos and Sheinbaum were in China to participate in the AELM, which was also attended by other leaders from the 21 member-economies of APEC. — BAP, GMA News
